text:
oliver: heads up — we started getting a wave of fsync latency spikes in ap-southeast1 around 03:12 UTC, GPU attach queue spiked. alert looks like local NVMe write stalls. anyone digging?
raj: seeing the same, fsync latency jumped 20-40x on scratchpool nodes. GPU provisioning backlog correlates with the spike. looks like heavy journaling flushes.
maria: this coincides with the janitor reclaim tweak we rolled yesterday (PR #4821) that forces synchronous flushes during tempfile reclaim. suspecting the change triggered the write wave.
storage-bot: [ALERT] nvme_iops_anomaly ap-southeast1 scratchpool avg_await=820ms, io_wait_inc=+18x — triggered 3 mins ago.
raj: quick snapshot from one affected host:
```
$ iostat -xz 1 3
Device:         r/s   w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await
nvme0n1       12.3  12050  512.0  16384.0  848.2
```
raj: write queue depth looked normal but fsyncs are waiting on completion from firmware, so everything backs up.
oliver: can we scale the janitor down briefly on the cluster? I'll make a targeted change to canary pool. command: `kubectl scale deploy/janitor -n scratch --replicas=0 --context=ap-southeast1-canary`
maria: rolling rollback queued. I'm starting a canary rollback to the previous janitor image on 10% of nodes. will monitor SMART counters and attach latency.
adele: note — this pattern (aggressive syncs) will increase write amplification and shorten NVMe life. please add a cost/erosion estimate for the postmortem.
raj: proposal for mitigation: 1) revert aggressive fsync behavior in janitor 2) add pacing + exponential backoff in reclaim loop 3) emit fsync/sec and fsync_wait_ms metrics per node 4) schedule SMART/firmware checks for the hot devices 5) throttle janitor on nodes with high await
oliver: I'll own metric work and a Grafana panel for fsync/sec and 'nvme.await' per node. will add an alert: 95p_await > 300ms for 3m.
maria: I'll push the rollback and open a PR for pacing. coordinating release window now.
oncall-triage: declaring incident sev3 — impacted GPU attach and a handful of customer workloads in ap-southeast1. scope: increased attach latency and temporary provisioning delays. next: acct exec/CS ping and prepare short status update.
raj: quick workaround applied: patched janitor image on canary -> attach backlog dropped ~60% after 8 mins. pushing to 50% now.
adele: :thumbsup: if rollback is safe then escalate to full region. also open ticket INF-7831 for tech debt and long-term pacing.
maria: posted rollback notes in the PR, linking to canary graphs. will coordinate roll-forward after we validate SMART and firmware metrics.
oliver: adding dashboard links and alert docs to the incident thread. assigning follow-ups: fsync metrics (oliver), janitor pacing (maria), device health sweep (raj), postmortem doc (adele).
storage-bot: [AUTOREMEDY] janitor scale set to 0 on 3 canary nodes by oliver at 03:40 UTC.
oncall-triage: thanks team — please paste short summary for the incident timeline when you have it so I can close the loop with CS and ops.
